conclusion: Nine Ministry exceptions have unique likely 1:1 app matches supported by shared INS code and name/parent context. One Qalaat entry remains unclear because the Ministry's unqualified name cannot be tied by code to the INS eastern row. No confirmed missing or wrong identity is established. Code and name evidence does not establish polygon reliability.
